meta.parties: Rajakariar v. The Provincial Road Committee of Jaffna

rules.statement: Long and uninterrupted possession, ut dominus, of land subsequently claimed to form part of the public highway raises a strong presumption that the land in question is the private property of the possessor.
rules.supporting_quote: "Although it may not be possible for a private owner to prescribe from the public highway by virtue of length of possession, yet long and uninterrupted possession, ut dominus, of land subsequently claimed to form part of the public highway, raises a strong presumption that the land in question is the private property of the possessor."
